title: Fix prompts for failed deliveries
items: A failed delivery to your own server has Copy prompt and Open in T3 Code: a short instruction for a coding agent that names the delivery and its request by id and the status, never their contents
Endpoints take an agent repository (GitHub owner/name) under Settings, Coding agent, or as agentRepo from the API, the SDKs, whk update-endpoint --agent-repo and the MCP server's update_endpoint
With an agent repository, failed-delivery alert emails link to the fix prompt in T3 Code
